# Code of conduct

Currency welcomes participants of every background and experience level. This policy applies to issues, pull requests and other project spaces, and when representing the project publicly.

## Expected behavior

Be respectful, considerate and constructive. Welcome questions, give actionable feedback, acknowledge mistakes and respect differing experiences and viewpoints. Critique ideas and code without attacking people. Respect personal boundaries and privacy.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, sexual attention, personal attacks, doxxing, and deliberate disruption are unacceptable. Do not publish someone else's private information without their permission or retaliate against anyone who reports a concern.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report concerns privately to the maintainer at dimasike.dev@gmail.com. Include relevant links, what happened and any immediate concerns. Do not post confidential reports in public issues. Reports are handled with respect for privacy; information may be shared only as needed to investigate or address the incident.

The maintainer reviews reports and may request clarification, remove or edit content, warn participants, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation, depending on severity and repeated behavior. Participants may use the same contact to request reconsideration and provide additional context. There is no guaranteed response time.

If a concern involves the maintainer, or you prefer an independent channel for abuse on GitHub, use [GitHub's abuse reporting process](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).
